svg.aria-label: How MindNest fits together: the patient's phone sends photos, voice and location to the AI and backend (Django REST, face recognition, embeddings, RAG, Gemini), which sends back reminders, answers and memory cues. The caregiver dashboard receives status and alerts and sets schedules, safe zones and familiar faces. A notification service delivers reminders and emergency alerts.

g.text: one app, two experiences, one careful AI in the middle
